test_integration_dora_cli: test the Dora CLI by running info, run, grid, export, and import commands via subprocess
run_cmd_subprocess_helper: run a Dora CLI command with the given arguments using subprocess.run with check=True
test_git_save_code_export: test the Dora git save feature by running experiments with the --git_save flag and verifying code folder creation
test_pickle_main_object: test that the Dora main object can be pickled and unpickled while preserving object identity
review_test_integration_functions: review the test_integration, test_git_save, and test_pickle functions to understand Dora CLI integration testing patterns
